cli  : `-T#` capped by liblz4 (1024 threads, 128 on 32-bit systems), replacing build macro `LZ4_NBWORKERS_MAX` ; `-V` tells if compression is multithreaded
cli  : output buffer no longer grows with the nb of threads : more threads within a memory budget (ex: 22 instead of 13 with `--memory=300M`)
cli  : a source file modified, renamed or replaced during its compression is detected, and kept with `--rm` ; error 54 when the output can't be verified
